change: Agent owner state, discovery policy, scoped service lease, preparation, readiness, drain and bounded stop move once into future-host. Entry retains probe and serving runtime construction, driving and teardown via an injected native driver. Host has an opaque consumed discovery result and scoped prepared-service callback; no internal mutex or raw Agent store is exposed.

productionRuntimeCheck.probe: current-thread enable_all; dropped before local-start scope
productionRuntimeCheck.agent: multi-thread enable_all; 2 workers; 32 blocking; 2 MiB stack; shutdown_timeout 1s; lifetime inside service cleanup scope

compatibility: Original FUTURE_DESKTOP_AGENT_MODE values and errors remain.
Agent singleton and endpoint/start permission logic still come from future-agent/future-rpc.
External ownership never receives Agent shutdown; stopped/failed/starting transitions and deadlines remain.
Log path stays app/logs/desktop.log; mirror uses the same future-agent logfile singleton.
No data, pairing, wire, approval, sandbox or requested-run cancellation changes.
fixtureAdjustment: The isolated stopping test now closes shared admission directly; Desktop full-coordinator tests retain integration coverage. Test-only native driver lives in cfg(test) module. Canonical real-loopback fixture is reused for attach policy cases. All original assertions and platform conditions remain.
limits: Static compilation does not establish runtime/lifecycle acceptance.
True process, RPC and database/Agent ownership tests need execution in subsequent CI.
Full business bridge, Remote host adapters, scheduling and exit coordinator are still in Desktop.
